description: This PHP class defines a plugin for delivery limitations based on date/time in the Revive Adserver project. It handles date parsing, display, and comparison operations for ad delivery restrictions.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLimitations_Time_Date
classes.description: A plugin class for date-based ad delivery limitations, supporting date parsing, display, and comparison operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with comparison operations and sets the plugin name.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin data, flattening the data structure.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is allowed in the current context, excluding 'channel-acl.php'.

methods.name: displayData
methods.description: Outputs HTML for date selection and calendar UI, expanding and flattening data as needed.

methods.name: getStoredTz
methods.description: Returns the stored timezone from the data string.

methods.name: _getCurrentTz
methods.description: Returns the current user preference timezone or 'UTC' if not set.

methods.name: _flattenData
methods.description: Converts date array into a flattened string format for database storage.

methods.name: _expandData
methods.description: Expands a flattened date string into an array with day, month, year, and timezone.

methods.name: getMpeClassInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of a class for Multi-Page Editing (MPE) integration.
